description: This PHP source file defines the ViewEmailConfigurationController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. The class extends an abstract controller and uses traits to manage configuration. It primarily prepares a Vue component with specific properties for rendering email configuration views, particularly setting the path to the sendmail executable.

classes.name: ViewEmailConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing the email configuration view by injecting relevant data into a Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the email configuration view component with the path to the sendmail executable.
